text: DSH UI Session Archive 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 网页端的会话归档界面插件。它在侧栏底部显示归档入口和数量，并在浮层面板中列出主机工作区注册表提供的已归档会话。列表按最近更新时间排序，展示会话与工作区信息，点击即可打开会话；面板可拖动和关闭。适合希望从侧栏整理入口并重新查看历史会话的网页端用户。

DSH UI Session Archive adds session history to the DeepSeek Harness web client. A counted sidebar entry opens a movable panel listing archived sessions from the host workspace registry. Rows show session titles, workspace details and update times; selecting a row opens that session.
想从侧边栏找回之前归档的 DSH 会话。
I want to browse archived DSH conversations and reopen one.
DSH UI Session Archive 的功能「查看并打开归档会话」：侧栏归档入口可打开浮层列表，列表展示会话标题、所属工作区和更新时间；点击一行即可打开对应会话。
DSH UI Session Archive 的功能「侧栏归档面板」：有归档会话时侧栏入口显示数量并切换面板；用户可拖动标题栏调整位置，也可用关闭按钮收起面板。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session-archive README · DSH Plugin: UI Session Archive：[中文](README.zh.md) | English

Provides **session archive management and restoration** features for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness) web interface, hiding inactive conversations from the main workspace list while keeping them accessible and restorable from a dedicated sidebar section.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session-archive README · Target Audience and Use Cases：Designed for users with many active conversations who want to keep the sidebar uncluttered while preserving complete historical transcripts for later review and restoration.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session-archive README · Key Features：- **One-Click Archive and Restore**: Archive sessions from the session action menu, and restore them back to their original workspaces from the sidebar footer.
- **Pure Slot-Based Composition**: Injects seamlessly through the `sidebar.workspaces.archive` slot without leaving redundant UI artifacts when unmounted.
- **Non-Destructive Lifecycle**: Archiving hides sessions from active grouping surfaces without altering underlying transcript logs or workspace records.
- **Readily Accessible History**: Archived conversations can still be opened and viewed directly from the archive disclosure.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session-archive README · Installation and Quick Start：Install a reviewed revision into your Web profile. The repository tracks prebuilt `lib/` artifacts, so Git installation requires no local build step:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:OpenSaozi/dsh-session-archive#<commit-sha>
```

After installation, refresh the page to access the "Archived (n)" disclosure at the bottom of the sidebar.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session-archive README · Compatibility：This plugin requires a DeepSeek Harness version whose `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` package declares the `sidebar.workspaces.archive` child slot.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session-archive README · Storage and Privacy：The plugin consumes only the host-owned workspace registry archive APIs and does not store prompt text, model responses, or private credentials.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session-archive README · What the model sees：Nothing. Archive and restore actions inject no `system` prompt text, messages, tool schemas, or provider request fields.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session-archive README · KV Cache effect：None; archive and restore operations do not issue or alter model inference requests.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session-archive README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work：- **Inspection and restoration only** — the archive disclosure focuses on history viewing and restoration, without nested session renaming actions inside the list.
